description: Slide and merge tiles to reach 2048, with controller and touch controls, undo, and saved progress

screens.name: HELP
screens.title: 2048 controls
items: Tilt the controller up, right, down or left, or tap an arrow to slide all tiles in that direction. A held tilt makes one move.
Turn the knob to select a direction, then press to move. The selected arrow is highlighted. BACK or Pause returns to the menu and saves.
Equal tiles combine into one tile, once per move. The merged value is added to your score. A new 2 or 4 appears only when the board changes.
Undo restores the position before your last move, including its score and next random tile. It is available once, including after game over. Your best score is kept.
Reach a 2048 tile to win, then choose Keep playing to continue. A full board ends the game only when no adjacent tiles can merge.
One extra direction can be queued during a slide animation. Further moves wait for a new input. Pausing clears that pending input; completed moves stay saved.
Calls, popups, leaving the app and vehicle movement pause play. Resume explicitly when ready. Parked only is on by default.

screens.name: NEW_GAME
screens.title: Start a new game?
items: Your current saved game will be replaced. Your best score is kept.
